The HWPX generation failed because the required 'High (즉시조치)' severity string was missing from the XML sections.
The test_overview_values_and_actions_are_present failed with an AssertionError during the call to subprocess.run for pytest. Specifically, the verifier could not find the string 'High (즉시조치)' within the combined content of section0.xml and section1.xml. While other tests passed, the failure in /tests/test_outputs.py:38 indicates that the severity mapping from the overview JSON was not correctly rendered into the HWPX XML structure.
